case.summary: The customer reported a $131.30 online purchase they did not make, and the investigation determined the transaction was fraudulent. Evidence showed the device profile used for the purchase was new for this card and had been shared with three other cards, indicating coordinated fraud, while one finding of a similar past purchase pointed to a genuine customer but was outweighed by the fraud signals. An analyst was consulted and confirmed the shared device profile links the other cards in a coordinated scheme. The case was closed as fraud, the card was blocked, a case was created, the connected cards will be monitored, and a report was filed. The next step is ongoing monitoring of the linked cards for any further suspicious activity.
